1. 1907 draft scheme. The award duly pronounced and notified to the agents of the parties settles the dispute definitively and without appeal (art. 22 cf art 81 of the Convention concerning the Pacific Settlement of International Disputes).
2. Five Neutral Powers. Same as 1907 draft. (art. 47)
3. Interparliamentary Union. Same as 1907 draft. (art. 15)
